SRC-160:R001.text: [CORE-001 P1] Malformed nested persistence must fail closed instead of normalizing to defaults: zaicodeAgentRepo.rowToDefinition (tool_policy_json, model_selection) and zaicodeJobRepo.rowToJob (delegation_json, actual_model_selection) currently turn unparsable JSON into undefined/{} before outer validation, so a damaged restrictive tool policy silently becomes the unrestricted yolo default.

SRC-160:R002.text: [CORE-002 P1] Auto Goal continuation budget must survive restart: zaicodeGoalSupervisor keeps intents/seq/continuations in a module-local Map, so observeZaicodeGoalFromBrief re-registers with continuations 0 and ZAICODE_GOAL_MAX_CONTINUATIONS=20 is spent again after each reload.

SRC-160:R003.text: [CORE-003 P1] Delegation admission must be atomic and scoped to the current parent run: delegateZaicodeJobFromRun counts via repo.listChildren then creates separately, so concurrent requests both pass maxChildrenPerParent; children carry no runId while the shared contract documents the budget per run.

SRC-160:R004.text: [CORE-004 P1] Audit cancel/retry must not swallow a failed runtime stop: zaicodeAuditService.cancel/retry call jobService.cancel(...).catch(noop) then set cancelled or enqueue a replacement wave while the queue service still refuses retry for cancel_stop_failed.

SRC-160:R005.text: [CORE-005 P1] Save All must not ship nested session/ephemeral state: captureZaicodeSettingsSnapshot raw-copies mixed families, and the checked-in zaicodeSettingsDefaults.json carries autoRetrySessions sess_ ids and autostart firedEvents/lastRunAt/lastResult.

SRC-160:R006.text: [CORE-006 P2] The shared job transition matrix must be authoritative: claimForDispatch claims blocked rows directly (blocked->running is not in the table) and resume/claim leave previous finished_at/session_id/actual_model_selection visible on the new attempt.

SRC-160:R007.text: [W2-001 P1] A dead queue lease must recover without a fresh restart: shutdown/restart inside the two-minute heartbeat window left running rows stranded, so host shutdown must release its own leases and a bounded reaper must reclaim stale rows after startup.

SRC-160:R008.text: [W2-002 P1] Retry safety state must survive renderer reload for the same live session: attempts, Stop-this-error, Stop-all and quota walls were module-local Maps, so a reload gave a fresh hard cap and dropped operator stops.

SRC-160:R009.text: [W2-003 P1] Scheduler stop-at-time must confirm stop before forgetting a run: stopZaicodeSessionRun returns true for a missing handle or a rejected stop, forget() runs before the stop attempt, and cancellation errors are swallowed before a false success notification.

SRC-160:R010.text: [W2-004 P1] Delegation spool requests must be run-scoped and crash-recoverable: dirFor keys only on parentJobId, scan submits with the current runId, .json->.taken->result has no recovery, and dispose() fences nothing.

SRC-160:R011.text: [W2-005 P2] Repository initialization must be fenced against close(): ensureReady can be parked in await mkdir while close() nulls state, after which the pending initializer reopens a DatabaseSync post-shutdown.

SRC-160:R012.text: [PERF-001 P1] The active queue poll must not load the whole durable history: zaicodeJobRepo.list has no limit/cursor, ZaicodeWorkspace polls every 3s while a job is active, and SAIHOME lists every workspace.

SRC-160:R013.text: [PERF-002 P1] Workspace refresh must be single-flight and generation-safe: refresh awaits five reads serially with no coalescing or stale-commit guard, so an old pass can overwrite a newer snapshot.

SRC-160:R014.text: [PERF-003 P2] Unchanged SAIHOME statistics must not rescan raw events: getHomeStats recomputes meta/buckets/breakdown over the full table on every feed refresh with no cache or generation.

SRC-160:R015.text: [PERF-004 P2] Pixel snap must react only to relevant geometry: a document-wide MutationObserver runs observeShell() synchronously per mutation batch plus a 1500ms heartbeat, scanning selectors and forcing layout reads.
